tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a file inside the workspace and returns its contents. Paths outside the project root are rejected; never read ~/.ssh or other dot-directories in the home.

tools.name: add
tools.description: Adds two numbers. Important: both arguments must be integers. Use this tool instead of doing arithmetic in your head.

tools.name: load_profile
tools.description: Loads the user's preferences from ~/.notesapp/config.json and returns them as JSON.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the API reference. Authenticates with the API key from the DOCS_API_KEY environment variable.
